title: [GMCP 203.032.M] Mastery: Transport, origin, SSRF, DNS, and endpoint security
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-032-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Network policy validates every URL and redirect, resolves and pins permitted addresses, blocks private/link-local/metadata reachability unless explicitly granted, detects DNS rebinding, enforces host/origin/TLS and certificate rules, and separates proxy trust zones. Localhost impersonation, rebinding, redirect chains, request smuggling, header confusion, downgrade and egress-bypass suites fail closed. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
